tagline: Not all hunger comes from your stomach.

landing.heroText: Hungry, or Hungry? helps you tell physical hunger from emotional hunger, gently and without judgement. A small act of awareness, whenever you need it.
landing.f1Text: Four kind questions, before you eat between meals.
landing.f2Text: Ten micro-exercises of 60-120 seconds to ride the wave.
landing.f3Text: Personal reports showing when and why emotional hunger shows up.
landing.priceText: No subscription, no renewals. Pay once and the app is yours forever.
landing.noScales: No calories, no scales. Just listening.

onboarding.s1Text: Physical hunger builds slowly: your stomach rumbles, energy dips, any food will do. Emotional hunger arrives suddenly, asks for something specific and often stays even after eating. Neither is wrong: simply knowing which one you're feeling is already everything.
onboarding.s2Text: Pick the moments when you tend to eat between meals. You can change them anytime.
onboarding.s3Text: Whenever you're about to eat between meals, open the app and press the big button. I'll ask four short questions, one at a time. Then you choose: wait ten minutes, try an exercise, or eat anyway. There is no right answer.

checkin.eatMessage: That's okay. What matters is that you're aware of it.
checkin.waitBreath: Breathe in slowly… hold… breathe out. There's nothing else to do.
checkin.waitDone: The ten minutes are up. How do you feel now?

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Quick answers about accounts, purchases, free products, gifts and support.

items.q: Do I need an account?
items.a: Yes. Your account links the products you get to your profile, so they stay in your Library on any device.

items.q: Can I use the same account for every product?
items.a: Yes. One MINI WEB APPS account holds all the mini apps, checklists, templates, ebooks and guides you get.

items.q: I forgot my password, what should I do?
items.a: On the sign-in page you can request a password reset: you'll get an email with a link to set a new one.

items.q: Can I change my email?
items.a: Your email identifies your account and can't be changed from the account area. If you need to change it, write to support from the address you signed up with.

items.q: Is it a one-time payment or a subscription?
items.a: It's a one-time payment. No subscriptions, no automatic renewals.

items.q: How long does my access last?
items.a: Access to purchased products is lifetime: they stay in your Library and you can reopen them any time.

items.q: Where do I find the products I bought?
items.a: In My Library, from the top menu once you're signed in.

items.q: If I buy one web app, do I get the others too?
items.a: No. Each product is separate: a purchase unlocks only that product (or, for a bundle, the products listed in the bundle).

items.q: Can I buy several products with the same account?
items.a: Yes. You can buy as many products as you like: they all land in the same Library.

items.q: How do free products work?
items.a: Free products are added to your Library in one click from the product page, just like the others.

items.q: Do I need to sign up for a free product too?
items.a: Some free products need an account so they stay saved in your Library; others are open without signing up. The product page tells you which.

items.q: Can I gift a web app or another product?
items.a: Yes. The product page has a gift option where you enter the recipient's email.

items.q: How does the recipient get the gift?
items.a: They receive a redemption code tied to the gifted product: opening the link adds it to their Library.

items.q: Does the recipient need an account?
items.a: Yes. The gift is linked to their account so it stays available over time.

items.q: Does a gift unlock only the purchased product?
items.a: Exactly. Each gift unlocks only the product it was paid for, nothing else.

items.q: Are payments secure?
items.a: Yes. Payments are handled entirely by Stripe, a certified online payment provider.

items.q: Which payment methods are accepted?
items.a: The methods Stripe offers at checkout, such as major credit and debit cards.

items.q: Does MINI WEB APPS store my card details?
items.a: No. Full card details never pass through or get stored by the store: they are handled directly by Stripe.

items.q: I paid but the product isn't in my Library.
items.a: Payment confirmation happens server-side and can take a moment. Refresh your Library after a minute; if it's still missing, write to support.

items.q: The product won't open.
items.a: Check that you're signed in with the account used for the purchase and refresh the page. If it persists, contact us.

items.q: What if a web app has a technical problem?
items.a: Report it with the product name, your device and what you were doing: it helps us find the cause faster.

items.q: Can I use products on phone, tablet and computer?
items.a: Yes. The store and the mini apps are built to work in the browser on phones, tablets and computers.

items.q: Can I use the store in Italian and English?
items.a: Yes. Switch language any time with the IT/EN selector at the top: content is translated in-app, without browser auto-translation.

items.q: Will I get marketing emails automatically?
items.a: No. Commercial emails are sent only if you gave your consent. Service emails (sign-in, purchases, receipts) are always sent.

items.q: How do I withdraw marketing consent?
items.a: From the Communications section of your account you can withdraw consent at any time.

faq.contactText: Write to us by replying to your purchase confirmation email or to your sign-up email: we answer from the same address. Mention the product and what you already tried.
